items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: They had Kenny Drew, Donald Bird, Ira Arnie Sullivan, and I forgot -- he used some bass player down in Washington in my place, but they came back the next morning, and our next engagement would be Washington for a week, and that's where I made it

ctx.x: I threw my outfit away because I contacted him and he said to go to this house when you get in town -- his sister in law's house, and he gives me a pep talk, and he had jobs lined up for me all the way to the West Coast, and we wasn't
gonna -- none of us were gonna use any drugs at all, and blah, blah, blah. Sure.

Anyway, I get to New York and Paul told me in the train station, 'Look, man -- we got a place out in East New York' - they had a little inn out there or something like that -- and he said, 'you can stay out there until you get on your feet', you know; And, because I was trying to find all kinds of excuses not to leave Chicago.
